verdict.rationale: Airwallex offers fast-to-integrate options for accepting online card payments quickly (Payment Links requiring no storefront, Hosted Payment Page, Drop-in Element, sandbox quickstart), which are consistent with a founder going live within a day. However, the evidence does not document the actual account-opening/KYC onboarding timeline or approval SLA for a brand-new founder signing up, which is the critical gatekeeper before any live payment can be accepted. Missing for 10: documented onboarding/KYB approval turnaround time, explicit same-day go-live confirmation, and independent/hands-on evidence of a founder completing signup-to-first-payment within 24 hours.
